resources.string: Deleting your account can\'t be undone.

Everything in it is removed: your profile, picture and context, tasks and their history, goals and milestones, habits and check-ins, calendar events, daily reviews, memories, and your conversations with Michael. You\'ll be signed out, and the email can be used for a new account.
